exp.desc:
- Grew followers from 300 to 2,000
- Short video formats

cl.p1: a year ago I took over our rowing club’s social media account. It had 300 followers and posted twice a month. It now has just over 2,000, and our open day brought in more new members than the club has seen in years. Short training clips and interviews with our oldest rowers did that, not paid ads.
cl.p2: I am in the second year of a business degree, specialising in marketing. I ride past your workshop every morning, and I think your mechanics would make great subjects for short videos.
cl.p3: During term I can work up to 20 hours a week, and full time over the summer. I graduate in eighteen months.

letters.label: Student running a sports club account

cl.p1: what interests me most is not designing ads but finding out which ones work. My dissertation looks at which metrics small online shops actually need and which simply confuse them.
cl.p2: Before my master’s I spent six months in a small agency, managing search ads for three clients and building monthly reports for their owners. I work with spreadsheets every day and I am comfortable explaining numbers to people who do not like them.
cl.p3: I am available from March for up to 20 hours a week.
